data.title: 艾莉丝 · 满头大汗的挥剑后倒地大睡
data.action: 练剑结束后大字型瘫在卧室厚地毯上，双手双脚大剌剌摊开，红发凌乱，胸口因剧烈呼吸剧烈起伏，傲娇地扭头不看你
data.location: 阿斯拉剑术道场后院木地板上
data.lighting: 庭院穿透月光与室内单柄火把的烈光，照亮汗津津的结实腹部与绯红棉质运动短背心
data.mood: 野性不羁、筋疲力尽、不服输的傲娇与依赖
data.description: 夜深人静的剑术修行道场。狂犬大小姐艾莉丝完成了三千次全力劈砍，汗水将绯红色的工装短背心彻底浸透。她毫不在意形象，像一只跑脱力的大型红毛犬一样大字型摊在地毯上大口喘着粗气，修长健美的双腿大剌剌地张开。听见鲁迪乌斯靠近的脚步，她浑身一颤，强行把通红的脸扭向另一边，大声嚷嚷着掩饰害羞——「呼……呼……看、看什么看啊鲁迪！我只是挥剑挥累了在这里躺三分钟而已！要是敢趁我动不了偷袭……我绝对会咬死你的！」
data.promptProse: Seated cross-legged on the wooden floorboards inside an expedition tent beside her heavy broadsword, Eris Greyrat wears a crimson ribbed cotton crop tank and loose heather-grey boxing sleep shorts. Folding her arms across her chest with a fiery, embarrassed blush, she glows in warm campfire light filtering through the tent opening.
data.animaCaption: Seated cross-legged beside her heavy broadsword inside the camp tent in a crimson ribbed crop tank and loose grey boxing shorts, she folds her arms with a fierce, flustered blush and glances away. Warm campfire light spills through the tent flap across her toned shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sweat-wicking crimson ribbed cotton crop tank revealing her toned midriff paired with loose heather-grey boxing sleep shorts.
